Akshay Kumar Film 'Welcome To The Jungle' Crosses ₹100 Crore at Box Office

The film 'Welcome To The Jungle', starring Akshay Kumar, has surpassed ₹100 crore in box office collection by its ninth day. The movie saw a significant increase in earnings on its second Saturday. Other films mentioned, 'Main Vapas Aaunga' and 'Alpha', had different performance trends.
